repositories._note: Authored in this repo, no upstream owner. Not synced and never stale — `authored: true` exempts it from sync and staleness checks. Tracked in git: this is the only copy. Evaluator use is OPT-IN PER FILE: only files with frontmatter `evaluator: include` and a status other than `unverified` are injected (scripts/lib/kb-client.js). kb/local/release/ (runbooks) is also excluded by directory.

SWORDHealth/ai-documentation — the product-authored docs injected into Phoenix's system prompts (constitution, 3WC world context, guardrail protocols, knowledge bases, evaluation rubric). Local checkout (clone over SSH; no GITHUB_TOKEN needed); refresh with `git pull` there. READ-ONLY: never edit, commit or push to this repo. Defaults to ~/sword-ai/<repo> when the variable is unset; a missing checkout → source skipped. Pulse docs alone are ~570 KB, far over tokenBudgetPerEval — see kb/README.md Known limitations before relying on injection.
